blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded as components in software systems, marketed under labels such as chatbot, copilot, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow, coding agent and AI agent. Whether these labels denote genuine architectural forms or serve as branding has not been assessed systematically.
  In the sources surveyed, labels do carry architectural content, most clearly in vendor usage: copilot denotes a router-worker architecture operating a host application under step-by-step user confirmation, while the more recent shift to the label agent coincides with AI-planned multi-step execution of which the user sees only the outcome. The coding agents of four major providers share one architecture, a reason-and-act loop delegating to subagents.
  This survey describes seven recurring forms---LLM chats, custom agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI-enhanced workflows, copilots, coding agents, and, in part, agentic RAG---in a common vocabulary of agents and tools. Each is characterized along four structural dimensions (agentic RAG only partially): the architectural pattern, the control of execution and the point of user intervention, the number of agent calls per task, and tool use. An illustrative corpus of 22 systems from research publications and vendor documentation grounds the descriptions and shows where they reach their limit.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLMS)越来越多地作为组件嵌入软件系统,在Chatbot,副驾驶,检索加载生成,工作流程,编码代理和AI代理等标签下营销. 这些标签是表示真正的建筑形式还是用作品牌,尚未得到系统的评估。
在被调查的资料来源中,标签确实带有建筑内容,最明显的是供应商的使用:副驾驶表示一个路由器-工作架构,在逐步用户确认下运行一个主机应用程序,而最近转向标签代理时恰逢AI计划多步执行,用户只看到结果. 四个主要供应商的编码代理商共享一个架构,一个原因和动作的环路授权给子代理商.
本次调查描述了7种反复出现的表格--LLM聊天,自定义代理,检索-增强生成(RAG),AI-增强工作流程,副驾驶,编码代理,以及部分代理RAG-在代理和工具的共同词汇中. 每个都具有四个结构维度的特征(代理RAG只有部分):建筑模式,执行控制和用户干预点,每个任务代理呼叫的次数,以及工具使用. 22个系统从研究出版物和供应商文件中得到说明,说明这些系统的理由,并显示其达到极限之处。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have moved beyond their initial role as conversational assistants. They are used as components inside software systems, where their output is consumed not by a human reader but by other pieces of software. Embedded in a program, an LLM no longer serves only as a content generator: it selects actions, parametrizes external services, and influences what happens next.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)已经超越了最初作为对话助理的角色. 它们被用作软件系统内的组件,其输出不是由人类阅读器而是由其他软件来消耗. 嵌入到一个程序中,LLM不再仅仅作为内容生成器:它选择动作,参数外服务,并影响接下来发生的事情.

blocks.en: A vocabulary for these systems has emerged along with them. Practitioners speak of chatbots, copilots, retrieval-augmented generation, workflows, AI agents and agentic AI, and vendors use the same terms in product names and branding. The terms are evidently useful, since they are used routinely and widely. What is missing is an account of what they denote: developer guides, engineering blogs and vendor material or product documentation describe what individual systems do, but rarely how they are built or how one form compares architecturally with another. LLM-integrated systems developed in research usually originate in an application domain, where this terminology is adopted rather than examined. Several of the terms appear to have been coined in the development and research laboratories of leading vendors and adopted by the academic literature afterward, rather than the reverse.
blocks.zh: 这些系统的词汇也随之出现。 从业人员讲的是聊天机,副驾驶,检索-增强生成,工作流程,AI代理和代理AI,而销售商在产品名和品牌上使用相同的名词. 这些术语显然有用,因为这些术语经常被广泛使用。 缺少的是说明它们的含义:开发者指南、工程博客和供应商材料或产品文件描述的是单个系统做什么,但很少说明它们是如何构建的,或者一种形式在建筑上如何与另一种形式相提并论。 在研究中开发的LLM-集成系统通常起源于一个应用领域,在这个领域采用而不是审查这一术语. 其中一些术语似乎是在主要供应商的开发和研究实验室中发明的,后来被学术文献采纳,而不是相反。

blocks.en:
It remains unclear whether the naming is largely arbitrary or whether these terms denote distinct categories of artifact and, if so, in what respects they differ.
The result is a field that is hard to survey for newcomers and practitioners alike, and in which researchers struggle to position their work and compare it with related approaches.
blocks.zh:
仍然不清楚的是,命名是否在很大程度上是任意的,或者这些术语是否表示不同的文物类别,如果是,在哪些方面它们有所不同。
其结果是难以为新来者和从业人员调查的领域,研究人员在其中努力将工作定位并与相关方法进行比较。

blocks.en:
This paper responds with a systematic description of the established
forms in a single, common vocabulary. Its primary contribution is one
of terminology and of conceptual groundwork, and only secondarily one
of analysis. In detail, the contributions are: • a set of concepts—AI agent, tool, monofunctional and
multifunctional agent, and recurring architectural patterns—in
which LLM-integrated applications can be described at the level of
whole system architectures; • uniform descriptions of seven forms established in practice but
not yet defined in a common vocabulary, each characterized along four
structural dimensions: architectural pattern, control of execution
and the point at which the user intervenes, number of agent calls per
task, and tool use; • an overview of 22 systems from research publications and vendor
documentation, which illustrates the descriptions, shows where they
reach their limit, and shows that the label copilot denotes one
architecture and one set of characteristics, while the shift to the
label agent marks a shift in architecture.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Conceptual work published by vendors presents catalogues of architectural
patterns intended as guidance for developers building LLM-based systems [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] .
Surveys of multi-agent systems (MAS) address collaboration mechanisms [ 4 ] , application domains [ 5 ] , or the conceptual distinction
between AI agents and agentic AI [ 6 ] . Masterman
et al. and Zhou et al. classify agent systems as single- versus
multi-agent and hierarchical versus decentralized architecture, but draw their examples from research prototypes [ 7 , 8 ] .
None of these works characterizes applications systematically.
blocks.zh:
销售商发表的概念性工作介绍建筑目录
用于指导开发者建立基于LLM的系统[1、2、3]。
对多种代理系统的调查涉及合作机制[4]、应用领域[5]或概念上的区别。
AI代理和代理AI之间[6]. 大师
等; 周克等. 将代理系统分类为单对单
多代理和分级结构与分散结构,但从研究原型中取出它们的例子[7,8].
这些作品都没有系统地说明应用的特点。

blocks.en:
In earlier work, the author proposed a taxonomy of LLM-integrated
applications that characterizes the individual model invocation, termed LLM
component, which corresponds to the notion of AI agent used in this paper.
That approach decomposes LLM-integrated applications into LLM components and
classifies each component along several dimensions [ 9 ] , but stops short of describing whole
system architectures.

在前作中,作者提出了LLM-融合的分类法.
单个模型引用特征的应用程序,称为 LLM
(a) 与本文件中使用的AI代理概念相对应的成分。
这种方法将LLM-集成应用分解为LLM组件并
将每个组件按照多个维度进行分类[9],但不能描述整个
系统架构。

blocks.en:
Closest to the present work is the taxonomy of Händler [ 10 ] , which classifies autonomous
LLM-powered MAS by their levels of autonomy and alignment, assessed per
architectural aspect. Its alignment axis is a finer-grained treatment of what
appears here as user control; its autonomy axis is related to our number of
agent calls per task. It covers one class of systems, applied to seven
open-source projects, and includes a workflow automation tool expressly as a
contrasting case; the present paper describes a broader range of forms in
uniform terms. To the author’s knowledge, no other work describes the range of
established forms in a single, common vocabulary at the level of application
systems.

blocks.en: III Agents and Tools
blocks.zh: 三. 代理人和工具

blocks.en:
The descriptions in Section IV refer to systems which
are assembled from smaller units. This section defines the terminology
adopted here.
blocks.zh:
第四节中的说明提到:
由较小单位组装。 本节定义了术语
在这里被收养。

blocks.en: III-A Invocation and Tools
blocks.zh: 三-A 召集和工具

blocks.en:
An LLM is used by invoking it with a prompt, as shown in
Fig. 1 . A prompt comprises several types of information: an
instruction or system prompt, which defines the general behavior of the
prompted LLM, such as “act as a helpful assistant”; a state or context part,
which informs the LLM about the current circumstances, such as a dialog
history; and the task it has to solve, such as a user’s question it has to
answer [ 9 ] .
An LLM cannot act; it can only produce text. Its scope is extended by giving
it access to tools .
The model uses a tool by emitting a call with parameters appropriate to the
task; the surrounding system executes it, holding the
function implementations, the service endpoints and credentials, or the
execution environment for generated code, and the result is optionally fed
into a further invocation from which the model formulates a response
(Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh:
使用LLM方法是用提示引用,如
图1 提示包括几种类型的信息:

引起LLM,例如“担任有帮助的助手”;状态或上下文部分,
它向LLM通报当前的情况,例如对话
历史;和它必须解决的任务,例如用户的问题,它必须
回答 [9].
LLM不能行动,只能产生文字. 通过提供
获取工具。
该模型使用一种工具,即发出一个带有适合
任务; 周围系统执行它, 持有
函数执行、服务终点和证书,或
生成代码的执行环境,结果可选择输入
以进一步援引的方式拟订答复
(图2).

blocks.en:
For the model to use a tool correctly, the prompts must describe when the tool
applies and how it is called. Tool integration has begun to standardize: the
Model Context Protocol defines a uniform format in which services describe the
functions they offer and how a model may call them [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh:
要让模型正确使用工具,提示必须描述工具何时使用
应用和如何称呼。 工具整合已开始标准化:
《示范环境议定书》界定了一种统一格式,服务在其中描述
函数和模型如何称呼它们。

blocks.en: III-B AI Agent
blocks.zh: III-B AI特工人员

blocks.en:
The terminology in the field of agentic AI has not yet converged. Some
authors call any prompt-and-response component an agent, for instance, in the context of custom agents in Subsection IV-B . Others require
tool use [ 12 ] , planning capability [ 13 ] , or a degree of autonomous control over the
flow of execution [ 14 , 2 ] . Agentic AI is treated by some as an umbrella term that includes
single-agent systems [ 1 ] and by others as a
synonym for MAS [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh:
代理AI领域的术语尚未趋同. 有点
作者将任何即时反应部分称为代理人,例如,第四至B分节中涉及海关代理人的部分。 其他要求
工具使用[12]、规划能力[13]或对
执行流量 [14, 2]. 代理 大赦国际被一些人视为一个总括术语,其中包括:
单剂系统[1]和由他人作为
MAS[6]的同义词.

blocks.en:
This paper adheres to a minimal definition: an AI agent is a
prompt-and-response system component, with or without access to tools. The term LLM agent would be more precise, but AI agent is
adopted because it has become established and is consistent with the
equally established term agentic AI . Under this definition, agents are the building blocks of agentic AI and of LLM-based software systems, i.e., systems that invoke LLMs.
blocks.zh:
本文遵循一个最低限度的定义:AI代理是
即时反应系统组件,有无工具。 LLM代理的术语会更精确,但AI代理是
因为它已经建立并符合
也一样, 在这个定义下,代理是代理AI和基于LLM的软件系统的构件,即引用LLMs的系统.

blocks.en: III-C Monofunctional and Multifunctional Agents
blocks.zh: 三-C 单功能和多功能代理

blocks.en:
What constitutes a given AI agent is its prompt, above all its
instruction or system prompt. It defines the agent’s behavior, while the
model that processes the prompt is in principle interchangeable. Agents can be designed with varying degrees of complexity.
A multifunctional agent performs a range of
functions, selects the appropriate one itself and decides on its
execution; typically a whole palette of tools is at its disposal, which
it selects and parametrizes autonomously.
A monofunctional agent fulfils only a delimited function, for example parametrizing a
single tool.
There is a continuum from strictly monofunctional to multifunctional agents, rather than a strict division.
blocks.zh:
特定人工智能代理人的构成是其迅速性,首先是其
指示或系统提示。 它定义代理人的行为,而
处理提示的模型原则上可以互换。 特工的设计可以不同程度地复杂.
多功能代理执行一系列
函数,自行选择适当的函数,并决定其
执行; 通常可以使用一个完整的工具调色板, 用于
它自主地选择和瘫痪。
单函数代理只履行一个被限定的函数,例如将一个函数参数化
单工具。
从严格单功能到多功能代理,有一个连续体,而不是严格的划分.

blocks.en: III-D Architecture Patterns
blocks.zh: III-D 建筑模式

blocks.en:
LLM calls can be combined and integrated into systems in countless ways. Among these, certain basic architectures are—with varying names—described in the literature [ 1 , 7 , 8 , 3 ] .
The following list names some of them.
blocks.zh:
LLM调用可被以无数方式合并并集成到系统中. 其中,某些基本建筑在文献[1、7、8、3]中有不同的名称。
以下列表列出了其中的一些.

blocks.en:
Monofunctional single agent and multifunctional single agent (Fig. 1 ), which may include tool use, have been described in Section III .
In the context of AI agents, the term workflow refers to applications in which the agents are embedded in a prescribed process. Workflows solve tasks over a sequence of process steps. Individual steps may be realized as agents, and the process supplies each agent invocation with data from the process context. The sequence is defined in advance and may contain conditional branches, but it is not composed dynamically by a model. A special case is the prompt-chaining workflow , consisting of a sequence of LLM calls, where the result of an LLM call is fed into the prompt of the next LLM call.
The router-worker architecture consists of a central router agent and a set of specialized worker agents. A worker is a subagent, typically monofunctional. An input to the system first reaches the router, which determines which of the system’s predefined tasks the input matches—intent detection—and then invokes the worker agent responsible for the detected intent with parameters extracted from the system environment and the input.
blocks.zh:
单功能单剂和多功能单剂(图1),可能包括工具的使用,已在第三节中说明。
在AI代理语境下,"工作流程"一词指代理被嵌入到规定流程中的应用程序. 工作流程通过一系列流程步骤解决任务. 个别步骤可以作为物剂实现,该工艺向每个物剂提供来自工艺背景的数据。 序列是事先定义的,可能包含有条件的分支,但并不是由模型动态地构成. 一个特例是快速链路工作流程,由一系列LLM调用组成,其中LLM调用的结果被反馈到下一个LLM调用的快取.
路由器-工人架构由中央路由器代理和一组专业工人代理组成. 工人是亚剂,一般为单能. 对系统的输入首先到达路由器,路由器决定系统预先确定的任务中哪些是输入匹配的——有意检测——然后用从系统环境和输入中提取的参数援引负责被检测意图的工人代理.

blocks.en: In the orchestrator-worker architecture a central manager agent plans and steers. It decomposes a task into subtasks and hands them to specialized workers by configuring their prompts; workers may run in parallel, and a further agent may consolidate the partial results.
blocks.zh: 在管弦乐-工作架构中,中央经理代理策划和指挥. 它将一项任务分解成分任务,通过配置其提示将其交给专门工人;工人可以平行运行,而另一个代理人可以巩固部分结果.

blocks.en: The planner-executor architecture, also called manager-worker, adds iterative refinement. The planner produces a work plan, workers execute subtasks and additionally return feedback, and the planner revises the plan and delegates again until the desired result is reached. The hierarchical planner-executor variant inserts intermediate planners: a high-level planner performs coarse planning and passes subtasks to subordinate planners that refine them, with workers executing at the leaves. All architectures involving calls to workers or subagents have analogous hierarchical variants.
blocks.zh: 规划者-执行者架构,也叫管理者-工作者,会增加迭代完善. 规划人员制定工作计划,工人执行分任务并额外回馈,规划人员再次修改计划和代表,直至达到预期结果. 分级规划者-执行者变体会插入中间规划者:高级规划者执行粗细规划,并将子任务传递给下级规划者加以精炼,由工人在叶子上执行. 所有涉及调用工人或子代理人的建筑都有类似的等级变体.

blocks.en: In the reason-and-act (ReAct) loop , a single multifunctional agent interleaves reasoning with tool calls in a loop: it reasons about what to do next, invokes a tool, evaluates the result in a further reasoning step, and repeats until it judges the task complete [ 16 ] . If the ReAct agent’s tools include subagents, it constitutes a further MAS architecture.
blocks.zh: 在"理性与行为(ReAct)"循环中,一个单一多功能代理在循环中与工具调用进行交互推理:它解释了下一步要做什么的理由,引用一个工具,在进一步推理步骤中评价结果,并重复到它判断任务完成[16]. 如果 ReAct 代理的工具包括子代理,则构成另一个MAS架构.

blocks.en:
These architectures vary in autonomy, that is, the degree of control left to an LLM within an agentic system. Some authors reserve the term autonomous MAS (AMAS) for architectures such as orchestrator-worker, reason-and-act, and planner-executor, where the number of LLM calls the MAS executes to fulfil a task is determined by an LLM rather than fixed, as in workflows or the router-worker architecture [ 1 ] .
Agent systems may go further still, writing automation scripts and defining prompts for subagents by themselves, thereby attaining far-reaching autonomy [ 13 ] .
Architectures without central control are also possible, notably peer-to-peer architectures in which agents divide the task among themselves and coordinate through mechanisms such as shared blackboards, voting or auctions.
In practice, centrally controlled architectures dominate in 2025: among published case studies of deployed MAS on one framework platform, the orchestrator-worker and router-worker architectures are the most frequent [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh:
这些架构在自主性上各有不同,即代理系统内LLM留给LLM的控制程度. 一些作者将自主MAS(AMAS)一词保留给管弦乐手-工作,理性-行为,以及规划者-执行者等架构,其中LLM调用MAS执行的任务的数量由LLM决定而不是固定,如工作流程或路由器-工作架构[1].
代理系统可能更进一步,自行写出自动化脚本并定义子代理的提示,从而实现深远的自主性[13].
不受中央控制的架构也是可能的,尤其是同行架构,其中代理商通过共享黑板,投票或拍卖等机制将任务分给彼此并进行协调.
实际上,中央控制的建筑在2025年占主导地位:在一个框架平台上部署的MAS的已公布案例研究中,管弦乐-工作与路由-工作架构最为频繁 [17].

blocks.en:
Agent systems may contain further agents that do not contribute to solving
the task but supervise it. Guardrail agents, for example, check the inputs
and outputs of other agents against safety rules, access rights or
compliance requirements and block or modify actions that violate them [ 18 ] . Such agents are a cross-cutting
concern, comparable to logging or authorization in conventional software:
they can be added to any of the architectures listed above without altering
it. They are therefore not treated here as architectural elements, and their
invocations are not counted among the agent calls per task.
blocks.zh:
代理系统可能含有不利于解决
任务,但监督它。 例如,警卫员检查输入
其他代理人违反安全规则、接触权或
遵守要求并阻止或修改违反要求的行动。 这些特工是交叉的
与常规软件的伐木或授权相当的关切问题:

blocks.en: IV Forms of LLM-Integrated Applications
blocks.zh: 四. LLM-综合应用形式

blocks.en:
This section describes established forms of LLM-integrated applications
by examples.
blocks.zh:
本节介绍LLM-集成应用的既定形式.
以实例表示。

blocks.en: IV-A LLM Chats
blocks.zh: 四-一 LLM 聊天

blocks.en:
LLM chats offer a dialogue interface to a model. In organizations they
are used for drafting texts of all kinds and for translation, and as a
convenient and powerful substitute for search engines, with the known
caveats that they occasionally produce fabricated information and that
their knowledge does not extend to the present.
Chat products typically work with multifunctional prompts, see for instance [ 19 ] . Users may request tool
use explicitly, or the model decides for itself.
blocks.zh:
LLM聊天为模型提供了一个对话框接口. 在组织中
用于各种文本的起草和翻译,并用作
方便和强大的替代搜索引擎,已知
警告说,它们偶尔会编造出捏造的信息,而且
他们的知识并不延伸到现在。
聊天产品通常使用多功能提示,例如,见[19]。 用户可能请求工具
明确使用,或模型自行决定。

blocks.en:
Behind a current chat product there may be
several models of different sizes together with a router that selects one
per user turn [ 20 ] .
The deep research
function offered by several chat products may be viewed as a tool within
the chat system, see Subsection IV-C .

blocks.en: IV-B Custom Agents
blocks.zh: 四-B 海关代理人

blocks.en:
Effective prompts are often extensive and hard to develop, since small
changes in wording can substantially change their effect. It therefore
pays to store successful prompts for recurring tasks. Several AI chat
platforms allow such prompts to be managed as custom agents in
their interface, and vendor-independent platforms offer the same across
models [ 21 ] . The names for custom agents differ by
platform. Often, tools can be attached, and some services operate
marketplaces in which custom agents are published and reused.
blocks.zh:
有效的提示往往很广泛而且难以发展,因为
措辞上的改变可以大大地改变其效果。 为此,

和供应商独立平台提供相同的接口

blocks.en:
An analysis of the custom agent landscape found that external application
integration remains comparatively rare, with most agents relying on
capabilities the host service provides [ 22 ] , and guidance
for the format recommends scoping each agent to a delimited task [ 23 ] . Custom agents also occur inside larger
systems: workflows use them as process steps [ 24 ] .

对定制代理环境的分析发现,外部应用
一体化仍然比较少见,大多数代理人依赖
东道方服务提供[22]的能力和指导

系统:工作流程将其用作流程步骤[24].

blocks.en: IV-C Retrieval-Augmented Generation
blocks.zh: IV-C 检索增强型

blocks.en:
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) [ 25 ] preserves
the usability of the chat interface while opening knowledge sources that
did not enter model training, such as an organization’s internal documents or specialized domain expertise.
RAG retrieves passages from the knowledge sources to generate answers, which reduces fabrication
(hallucination), and makes the supporting documents or entries
explicit, so that an answer can be checked against them [ 26 , 27 ] .
RAG is among the most successful applications of LLMs in professional
settings. The following sections discuss two variants: RAG in the narrow
sense, and agentic RAG.
blocks.zh:

打开知识源时聊天界面的可用性
没有参加示范培训,例如一个组织的内部文件或专门领域的专门知识。
RAG从知识来源取出段落生成答案,从而减少捏造
(吸入),并制作证明文件或条目
明确,以便对照这些答复[26,27]。
RAG是LLMs在专业领域最成功的应用之一.

blocks.en: IV-C 1 Narrow Sense RAG
blocks.zh: IV-C 1 窄宽度RAG

blocks.en:
RAG in the narrow sense goes back to [ 25 ] and is
suited to large, heterogeneous and largely unstructured document
collections, such as manuals, project reports or case records built up
over years. In the form common today, the collection is prepared in
advance: text is extracted from the source formats, split into chunks,
converted into vectors by an embedding model and stored in a vector
database.
At query time, the same embedding model converts the user’s
question into a vector, and the system retrieves the chunks whose
vectors are most similar. These are inserted into the prompt, from which
an LLM then generates the answer.

blocks.en: IV-C 2 Agentic RAG
blocks.zh: IV-C 2 代理RAG

blocks.en: Agentic RAG denotes approaches for searching large and frequently changing content such as company websites, intranets, wikis, document collections or databases. Retrieval is performed by appropriate mechanisms invoked as tools, such as web search, enterprise search, and database queries [ 28 , 29 ] . In Agentic RAG, agents decide what to retrieve. Many architectures have been proposed [ 30 , 31 , 32 ] , ranging from single-agent loops with retrieval tools to multi-agent and hierarchical designs. Deep research systems are a special form of Agentic RAG [ 31 ] . A detailed study of the architectures of agentic RAG products [ 33 , 34 ] and deep research systems [ 35 , 36 , 15 ] is beyond the scope of this paper.
blocks.zh: 代理RAG表示搜索大型且频繁变化的内容的方法,如公司网站,内联网,维基百科,文档收藏或数据库等. 检索由作为工具援引的适当机制进行,例如网络搜索、企业搜索和数据库查询[28、29]。 在Agentic RAG中,特工们决定取回什么. 提出了许多架构[30,31,32],从有检索工具的单代理环到多代理和分级设计. 深层研究系统是Agentic RAG的一种特殊形式 [31]. 对代理RAG产品[33,34]和深层研究系统[35,36,15]的架构的详细研究超出了本文的范围.

blocks.en: IV-D AI-Enhanced Workflows
blocks.zh: IV-D 强化工作流程

blocks.en:
Besides denoting an architectural MAS pattern, the term workflow also
denotes a class of software that predates the current wave of agentic AI:
platforms for robotic process automation (RPA), workflow automation and
business process management.
The platforms target trained end users with low-code or no-code environments in
which workflows are assembled by arranging and connecting prefabricated blocks
in a graphical user interface. Many of these established platforms have been
extended with blocks that invoke LLM agents; these agents are
configured in dedicated agent-builder areas [ 37 , 38 ] . For instance, such agents draft
replies to customer e-mails, summarize incoming messages or route
them to the responsible staff member.
One platform aimed at IT
professionals makes agent invocations available as modeling elements within
process models expressed in the standardized Business Process Model and
Notation (BPMN) [ 39 ] . Another is
source-available, can be self-hosted and used with arbitrary models, including
local ones, which helps to satisfy strict data protection requirements, for
example in public administration [ 40 ] .
blocks.zh:
除了表示一个建筑MAS模式外,工作流程一词也
表示在目前代理AI波之前的一类软件:
机器人流程自动化(RPA)、工作流程自动化和
业务流程管理。
平台目标培训的最终用户有低码或无码环境
通过安排和连接预制块来组装哪些工作流程
在图形用户界面中。 这些既定平台中有许多是
以引用 LLM 代理的块扩展;这些代理是
在专用代理-建材区配置 [37, 38]. 例如,这些代理人起草
对客户电子邮件的答复,摘要说明收到的邮件或路线
(b) 向负责工作人员提供。

专业人员将代理人援引作为在
标准化业务流程模型和
标注 (BPMN) [39]. 另一个是

有助于满足严格数据保护要求的当地标准
公共行政方面的例子[40]

blocks.en:
The workflows are typically triggered by events or schedules and then run
unattended. Systems may provide checkpoints at which humans inspect
intermediate results, either on every execution or only where a decision is
flagged as critical or falls below a confidence threshold [ 41 ] ; outside these checkpoints,
intermediate results remain uninspected.
blocks.zh:
工作流程通常由事件或时间表触发,然后运行
无人照顾. 系统可以提供检查站,供人类检查
中期结果,或每次执行,或仅在决定作出时
标记为临界值或低于信任阈值[41];在这些检查站之外,
中间结果仍未得到检查。

blocks.en:
By contrast, the LLM ecosystem offers programming frameworks for building
agentic workflows, together with visual builders layered on top of them [ 42 , 43 , 44 ] . These address
developers and permit more flexible MAS architectures than the prefabricated
blocks of the low-code platforms.

相比之下,LLM生态系统为建设提供了方案编制框架。
代理工作流程,连同上方分层的视觉构建器[42,43,44]. 这些地址
开发并允许比预制件更灵活的MAS架构
低码平台的块。

blocks.en: IV-E Copilots
blocks.zh: 四-E 副驾驶

blocks.en:
Copilot has become an established term for LLM-integrated systems.
Our survey of commercial systems and research prototypes labeled copilots
aims to identify their common characteristics. It draws on vendor
documentation and, as this is often not very detailed, also on direct
inspection of the systems and on the findings of an
interview study with engineers building product copilots [ 45 ] . Table I summarizes the
results.

The same vendor’s copilot for CRM and ERP is likewise a set of delimited

In a further ERP suite the assistant contains workers that execute tasks

An industrial vendor develops copilots along the value chain, from design

blocks.en: IV-E 2 Research Prototype Copilots
blocks.zh: IV-E 2 研究原型副驾驶

blocks.en:
A product configuration copilot
provides a chat interface for a product configurator. It
translates natural-language user input into a format the constraint resolver
can process automatically, and phrases the results in natural language for
the user [ 53 ] . This copilot operates an existing
application, and the user can see and correct the effect of the operation
immediately. With only one supported intent, the setup is too simple to
require routing.
An agricultural copilot operates an Agricultural Data Management and Analytics (ADMA) platform. Its controller agent
infers the user’s intent, determines which of a
platform’s tools and processing steps the intended analysis requires,
parametrizes them, and coordinates their execution following a predefined meta-program graph [ 54 ] . This resembles the
orchestrator-worker architecture of Subsection III-D more than the
router-worker one.

A copilot for manufacturing equipment selection follows the router-worker
pattern at the level at which the user interacts with it, while one of its

than by the user, who is consulted only when that check fails [ 55 ] . This copilot accesses knowledge, but does not

blocks.en: IV-E 3 Characteristics of Copilots
blocks.zh: 副驾驶的特点

blocks.en:
Typical copilots operate existing application software, visibly performing
steps previously done by hand; commercial ones are frequently integrated
directly into the host product. Architecturally, they follow a router-worker
pattern: the user states a goal in a chat window, the copilot detects the
intent, and specialized workers carry it out. Because the effect of each
operation is visible, the user can keep it or refine it in further turns.
Some copilots additionally propose contextually appropriate actions, for
example as buttons triggering the corresponding intent.
blocks.zh:
典型的副驾驶操作现有应用软件,明显性能
以前手工完成的步骤; 商业步骤常常是一体化的
直接进入主机产品. 在建筑学上,他们跟随路由器-工人
模式:用户在聊天窗口中表示一个目标,副驾驶检测
由专门工作者执行。 因为每一个的影响
操作是可见的,用户可以保存或再进一步精炼.
一些副驾驶还提出了适合具体情况的行动,以便
例如,触发相应意图的按钮。

blocks.en: IV-E 4 Shift of Labels
blocks.zh: 四-E 4 标签的转换

blocks.en:
The survey indicates that vendors use the terminology more consistently than
researchers do. More recently, vendors have begun to brand their AI products
as agents, in addition to or instead of as copilots, and this shift of labels
coincides with a change in architecture. One ERP provider explicitly
announces its AI agents as a move from “just AI copilot” to “AI
orchestrator” [ 59 ] ; a comparable statement is made
with respect to industrial copilots [ 56 ] ,

blocks.en: TABLE II: Forms of LLM-integrated applications
blocks.zh: 表二:LLM-综合应用的形式

blocks.en: IV-F Coding Agents
blocks.zh: IV-F 编码代理人

blocks.en:
Among the emerging forms of AMAS applications that share a common architecture are coding agents for software development.
They are built around an agentic loop that delegates work to subagents [ 62 , 63 , 64 , 65 , 1 ] . A coding copilot (GitHub Copilot) has since been extended with an agent mode that follows the same pattern [ 61 ] .
blocks.zh:
共享共同架构的AMAS应用程序的新兴形式包括软件开发的编码代理.
它们是围绕一个代理循环构建的,代表工作到子代理[62,63,64,65,1]. 编码副驾驶(GitHub Copilot)从此被扩展,代理模式遵循了相同的模式[61].

blocks.en: IV-G Planner-Executor Example System
blocks.zh: IV-G 规划者-执行者示例系统

blocks.en:
A further AMAS example is Anthropic’s Research feature. Its developers describe it as a multi-agent architecture in which a lead agent analyzes the query, devises a research strategy and delegates subtasks to subagents that run in parallel, then synthesizes their findings and decides whether further research is needed; if so, it spawns additional subagents or revises its strategy [ 15 ] .
Although its developers name it an orchestrator-worker AMAS, this comes close to the planner-executor pattern as defined in this paper.
The correspondence is not exact: the subagents are themselves tool-using agents that search, evaluate intermediate results and reformulate their own queries, so they are considerably more autonomous than executors in the classical sense; and planning is interleaved with execution rather than completed up front.
blocks.zh:
Anthropic的研究特色是AMAS的另一个例子。 其开发者将其描述为一个多代理架构,其中由主导代理分析查询,设计出研究策略并授权子任务给平行运行的子代理,然后综合其研究结果并决定是否需要进一步的研究;如果需要的话,它会产生额外的子代理或修改其策略 [15].
尽管它的开发者将其命名为管弦乐-工作AMAS,但这与本文所定义的规划者-执行者模式接近.
函证不准确:子剂本身是使用工具的代理人来搜索,评价中间结果并重写自己的询问,因此比起古典意义上的执行者,它们具有相去甚远的自主性;而规划则与执行相接而来,而不是在前面完成.

blocks.en: IV-H Summary of Selected Systems
blocks.zh: IV-H 选定系统摘要

blocks.en:
To illustrate the descriptions given above, Table II summarizes
the forms, together with the system instances for which this study found no
established form. For each entry it records four properties: the architectural
pattern, the point at which a human user intervenes, the number of agent calls
per task, and the tools available to the agents. The entries combine
commercial products, for which vendor documentation is the principal source,
with research prototypes, for which peer-reviewed descriptions are available; see Section V-D for discussion.
blocks.zh:
为说明上述说明,表二概述:
表格,以及本研究发现没有的系统实例
确定的形式。 每个条目记录四个属性: 建筑
模式, 人类用户干预的点, 代理通话次数
每个任务,以及代理人可用的工具。 条目结合
商业产品,供应商文件是其主要来源,
附有研究原型,有同行评审的描述; 讨论见V-D节。

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en:
This study asks which structurally similar forms of LLM-integrated systems have already emerged, given that interest in and development of these systems began less than four years before this study. It investigates whether the labels applied to LLM-integrated systems denote actual forms beyond mere branding, and, where they do, what characteristics constitute each label.
The study focuses on structural dimensions to characterize the systems, including system architecture, degree of user control, number of agent calls per task, and tool use, as such characteristics make it possible to describe newly developed systems in new application areas.
blocks.zh:
这项研究询问,鉴于本研究不到四年就已开始对这些系统的兴趣和发展,已经出现了何种结构上类似的LLM-集成系统。 它调查了适用于LLM-集成系统的标签是否除了仅仅标出品牌以外,还指实际的形式,以及每个标签的特性。
研究侧重于系统特征的结构维度,包括系统架构,用户控制程度,每个任务的代理呼叫次数,以及工具使用,因为这些特征使得在新的应用领域描述新开发的系统成为可能.

blocks.en: V-A Scope and Granularity
blocks.zh: V-A 范围和外观

blocks.en:
The study does not aim to provide a taxonomy that sorts systems into separate,
mutually exclusive categories, nor to map a fine-grained design space for
developers or to serve as an analytical instrument for detailed architectural
research. It characterizes LLM-integrated systems at a general level, which is
what its purpose requires: to provide an accessible framework for
practitioners, students, and newcomers to the field, and to help position and
label systems using established, common terms.
blocks.zh:
研究的目的不是要提供一种分类法,将系统分解成独立的,
相互排斥的类别,也不用于绘制精细设计空间图
或作为详细建筑设计的分析工具
研究。 它在一般层面上的LLM-集成系统的特点,即
其宗旨要求:提供无障碍框架,供
执业者、学生和外地新人,以及
使用既定、通用术语的标签系统。

blocks.en: V-B Labels and Architectural Distinctions
blocks.zh: V-B 标签和建筑区分

blocks.en:
The survey indicates that vendors use the label copilot consistently, as detailed in Section IV-E . The subsequent shift to agent is
accordingly more than a change in fashion, as it marks a move from
AI-selected single steps that the user confirms to AI-planned multi-step
execution of which the user sees only the outcome.
The survey also found that the coding agents of four major providers are similar along the structural dimensions examined. For RAG in the narrow sense, the characteristics were derived from the original formulation [ 25 ] ; the survey did not investigate to what extent products or prototypes branded as RAG exist and conform to this definition.
The study introduces its own label, AI-enhanced workflow, to the author’s knowledge there is not yet a common label for this form.
blocks.zh:
调查显示,供应商一致使用标签副驾驶,详情见第四节至E节。 接下来转到代理是
因此,这不仅仅是一种时尚的改变,因为它标志着一个从
AI选择的单步,用户向AI计划多步确认
执行中,用户只看到结果。
调查还发现,四个主要提供者的编码剂在所审查的结构层面类似。 对于狭义的RAG,其特性取自于最初的配方[25];调查没有调查作为RAG品牌的产品或原型在多大程度上存在并符合这一定义.
研究向作者介绍了自己的标签,AI强化了工作流程,据作者所知,目前还没有这种表格的共同标签。

blocks.en: V-C Nested and Hybrid Architectures
blocks.zh: V-C 嵌入式和混合式建筑

blocks.en: LLM-integrated systems are complex and vary in their details; MAS in particular can be designed very flexibly. Diverse, hybrid, and nested architectures are possible and common.
blocks.zh: LLM-集成系统很复杂,其细节也各不相同;尤其是MAS可以非常灵活地设计. 多样化,杂交,和被窝式建筑是可能的并常见的.

blocks.en: The Equipment Selection Copilot [ 55 ] is an example: at the level the user interacts with, it is a router-worker copilot, but one of its workers is internally a workflow of several chained model invocations.
blocks.zh: "设备选择副驾驶"[55]就是一个例子:在用户互动的级别上,它是一个路由器-工作器副驾驶,但其一位工人在内部是一个由多个连锁模型引用而来的工作流程.

blocks.en:
As agentic systems become more common, more such nested architectures are expected to appear, as copilot-type and chat-type systems become enhanced with MAS-type workers and tools. The chat or copilot pattern acts at the user-interface level, which starts the agentic workers or tools autonomously, in cooperation with, or with confirmation from, the user.
For these cases, it is suggested that the classification be drawn at the user-facing level, with the internal nesting recorded as a property of the respective workers, rather than treated as a separate system form.
blocks.zh:
随着代理系统越来越普遍,随着副驾驶型和聊天型系统随着MAS型工人和工具的增强而出现更多的这样的嵌入式建筑. 聊天或副驾驶模式在用户界面一级发挥作用,即自动启动代理工人或工具,与用户合作或由用户确认。
对于这些案例,建议在用户形成层次上取出分类,内部筑巢记录为相应工人的财产,而不是作为单独的系统形式处理.

blocks.en: V-D Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: V-D 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
Systems were characterized by a single author from published descriptions;
for several commercial systems, these, necessarily, are vendor sources that disclose only a certain level of technical detail; in some cases, the characterization is based only on what the vendor states. The corpus is
illustrative rather than representative, and no frequency claims follow
from it. Independent second coding, and characterization
against technical rather than promotional sources where these become
available, would strengthen the observations.
blocks.zh:
系统的特点是,从公布的描述中只有一位作者;
对于一些商业系统来说,这些必然是只披露某种程度技术细节的供应商来源;在某些情况下,定性只依据供应商所述内容。 炸弹是
说明性而非代表性,随后没有频率要求
从它。 独立的第二个编码和特征
对技术而不是促进来源,如果它们成为
将加强观察。

blocks.en: The descriptions were developed over a period in which the field changed substantially: products marketed as copilots acquired capabilities now marketed as agents, and AMAS moved from research prototypes to commercial offerings. New forms of LLM-integrated systems keep emerging, for example locally hosted, user-configurable personal assistants that read and write files, run commands, and browse the web on the user’s own machine [ 66 ] . Extending the study to such new forms, and to further existing forms such as Deep Research and Agentic RAG, is a natural direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 这些描述是在外地发生重大变化的时期制定的:产品作为副驾驶销售,现在作为代理商销售,AMAS从研究原型转向商业供货。 LLM-集成系统的新形式不断出现,例如本地主机,用户可配置的个人助理读取并写入文件,运行命令,并浏览用户自己机器上的网络[66]. 将研究扩大到这种新形式,并进一步推广诸如 " 深层研究和代理RAG " 等现有形式,是今后工作的自然方向。

blocks.en: Matching forms of LLM-integrated systems to other kinds of AI-based system not built on LLMs could help clarify their relation to the more recent forms of agentic AI; transactional chatbots [ 67 ] and the expert systems of the 1990s [ 68 ] are two examples.
blocks.zh: 将LLM-集成系统的形式与并非基于LLMs的其他基于AI的系统相匹配,有助于澄清它们与更近期的代理AI形式的关系;交易聊天器[67]和1990年代的专家系统[68]是两个例子.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en:
Many terms for LLM-integrated systems—chat, custom agent,
agentic RAG, RAG, copilot, coding agent, etc.—are
applied routinely in practice but have, with exception of RAG, not been
described in the research literature in a way that states uniformly how
the systems behind them are built.
blocks.zh:
LLM-集成系统的许多术语——聊天,自定义代理,
代理RAG、RAG、副驾驶、编码代理等
实践中的常规应用,但除RAG外,没有
在研究文献中以统一的方式描述
他们背后的系统已经建成。

blocks.en:
This paper has described six forms of such systems in full, and a seventh in part,
illustrated by a survey of 22 systems characterized from vendor sources,
own inspection, and video material, and informed by research
publications, survey papers, and other secondary sources. Each form is
characterized by its architecture, by the role left to the human user,
by the number of agent calls per task, and by the tools its agents use.
blocks.zh:
本文全面介绍了六种形式的这种制度,第七种形式是:
对22个供应商系统进行的调查就说明了这一点,
自己的检查和录像材料,并参考研究
出版物、调查论文和其他次要来源。 每种形式
其特征是它的架构, 以及留给人类用户的角色,
根据每个任务的代理呼叫次数,以及其代理使用的工具。

blocks.en:
The classification is offered as a means of relating these systems to
one another: to make the field more accessible for newcomers and in
teaching, to give practitioners a basis for comparing technologies, and
– as a theoretical and conceptual contribution—to introduce the
emerging terminology into the research literature so that studies can
refer to it.
blocks.zh:
提供这种分类是将这些系统与
互通:使外地更便于新来者和进入
教学,为从业人员提供比较技术的基础;
- 作为理论和概念上的贡献,引入
研究文献中新出现的术语,以便研究能够
参考它。
